summary: Arterial kerb beside golf course trees, no parked cars, no room off the lane.
reasons: No verge, trees at kerb edge

best_section.where: Indooroopilly Road east kerb, beside the golf course tree line

drivers.seclusion: Golf course and trees on the east side, but dwellings sit 11 m away at the south end and 17 m at 17 m along.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight into trees with no verge or pull-in; a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Indooroopilly Road is a through route with steady traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb in either image.
